output.summary: The user asked why their A1C rose from 6.8 to 7.4 despite no perceived routine changes, and whether age explained it. They described six months of disrupted sleep and loud snoring, plus modest winter weight gain; the assistant discussed possible contributors and suggested a two-week diary and questions for their doctor about sleep evaluation, an individual A1C target, and home monitoring. The user summarized the plan, said it was useful, and ended the conversation appreciatively.
